entirely irrelevant to your claim that TK is himself
PC, or that he harbors secret leftist sympathies, 
as you and others in this forum so desperately wish 
to believe.

>

Your argument seems very weak.  Can you name
someone who agrees with all those ideas and
who would not be called a leftist?  Yes, I 
knew you couldn't. ;-)

Do you now want to deny that you are PC, sweetie?

can you?  Your hypersensitivity to race issues,
your feminist's pathological hatred of men, your

Not really.  TK never mentions any political
rightists that would fit the definition.  At
most, he hedges some more ("Presumably..", above),
and only admits that it is a possibility.  Thus,
your confusion stems from the fact that TK is
himself a little muddy on the distinction.  But
the True Believer he refers to above is really
a superset comprised of the leftist and "rightist"
(though Nazis are not really on the right)
psychological types, insofar as there is any 
similarity at all.  Typically, they have little 
in common, psychologically, with leftists.  
Leftists such as yourself little Suzie are 
characterized by masochism, and sublimated 
and projected self-hate, to a very large degree.  
As TK also notes, this is reflected in their 
neurotic pursuit of an imaginary "equality", 
among other things.
